name: Transformations
description: How the same message moves from one format to another: down into smaller formats, up into larger ones, across into formats of the same size.

sheets.name: Format transformations
sheets.title: Format × format
sheets.description: How the same message moves from one format to another. Key is the source format; the format columns are the target. Down = into a smaller format (break apart), Up = into a larger format (build up), Across = into a format of the same size. Read a row for what a format can become, a column for what it can be built from. A pair is marked where a content unit's Repurposes into carries its message into the other format, in either direction; the formats' Typical length sets the direction. A blank means it is not a default transformation.

sheets.name: Candidates
sheets.title: Candidates
sheets.description: Format pairs not marked in Format transformations that content units or recipes point at: a unit whose format repurposes into the target, or a recipe with both formats as options. Marker is the direction Typical length gives. A pair moves into Format transformations only when it is marked there by hand; a pair with Content units contradicts the matrix and is read first.
